full_judgment:
Md Ashfaqul Islam J: In an application under Article 102 of the Constitution this Rule was issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the purported investigation report of the respondent No. 3 and cancellation of the mutation cases being Mutation Case Nos. 13610 of 04 and 16962 of 04 issued by the respondent No.5 in respect of the properties of the petitioners of 2.99 acres of land appertaining to CS Khatian Nos. 11 and 12, CS and SA Dag Nos. 21, 23 and 86 of Mouza Purbo Nara- shinghapur, Police Station-Ashulia, formerly Savar, Dhaka as requested by the demand of justice notice dated 12-7-2007 (Annexure-A) shall not be declared to be void and to have been made without any lawful authority and is of no legal effect. 

 2. Facts relevant for the disposal of the Rule, in brief, are that the petitioners in this writ petition impugned the purported cancellation of the mutation of the names of the petitioner Nos. 2 and 3 relating to Mutation Case No. 13610 of 04 and 16962 of 04 by the respondent No. 5 Assistant Commissioner (Land) Savar, Dhaka, pursuant to a purported report of the respondent No.3 Additional District Magistrate, Dhaka in respect of 2.99 acres of land at CS Khatian Nos. 11 and 12, CS and SA Dag No.2, 23 and 86 of Mouza-Purbo Narshinghapur, Police Station-Ashulia, formerly Savar, Dhaka. It is stated that petitioner Nos. 2 and 3 purchased a total of 2.99 acres land from petitioner No.1. The said properties were purchased by the petitioner No.2 by registered Deed No. 13426 dated 30-4-2004 and the petitioner No.3 by registered Deed No. 13427 dated 30-6- 2004 which were duly mutated in the names of the said petitioner Nos. 2 and 3 being Mutation Case No. 13610 of 2004 and 16962 of 2004. It is alleged that the impugned order of cancellation has been done behind the back of the petitioners. In other words, the impugned order of cancellation was passed by the respondents upon an investigation alleged to have been done beyond the knowledge of the petitioners.
